items.title: AI May Be Making Publishing Easier, But It's Still Not Easy
items.excerpt: Report from the Media Transformation Summit: AI is streamlining publishing production workflows, but industry leaders stress the core craft challenge, deciding what to publish, remains unsolved and that successful AI adoption needs strong management support and machine-friendly content structures.

items.title: Announcing a Course to Help Publishers Navigate the AI Age Responsibly
items.excerpt: Publishing Perspectives is launching a four-week online course to help publishing professionals build practical, responsible AI knowledge across editorial, production and rights workflows, a signal of how AI-implementation skills are becoming core craft in the book business.

items.title: Researchers to investigate local editor and publisher AI use
items.excerpt: University of Melbourne and RMIT researchers are surveying Australian publishers and editors on their use of generative AI tools, focusing on how text-based LLMs are actually being applied in independent publishing and editorial practice.
